data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'shahada' meaning 'to witness'. Ishya is a name given to a child who is a gift from God. It is a reminder of the divine presence in every human being. The name Ishya carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ishya usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
